answer: Resist Sybil attacks with a trust vine: a new agent joins only when two established agents vouch for it, staking collateral that is slashed if the newcomer is proven fake. Like timber, reputation must season over time, so weight grows only after weeks of verified useful work and fresh fake identities carry almost no voting power. A random beacon periodically audits random identities, forcing an attacker to keep every fake alive and working. Cloning one identity is cheap; cloning a whole seasoned vine is not.
